headline: Price of 12kg LPG cylinder rises by Tk 252, now Tk 1,837
summary: Consumers are facing increased costs and supply shortages, with many already paying far above the official rate.
details: The price of a 12kg LPG cylinder in the private sector has increased by Tk 252, bringing the new price to Tk 1,837.
This price hike comes amid ongoing supply shortages, further adding to the woes of consumers across the country.
Reports indicate that many consumers are already paying prices far above the official rate to secure fuel.
The increase is affecting households and small businesses that rely on LPG for their daily cooking and operational needs.
caption:
LPG prices jump by Tk 252. Consumers are already paying way more than the official rate.

The price of a 12kg LPG cylinder in the private sector has increased by Tk 252, bringing the new price to Tk 1,837.

Reports indicate that many consumers are already paying prices far above the official rate to secure fuel.

The increase is affecting households and small businesses that rely on LPG for their daily cooking and operational needs.

headline: Ex-CEC Habibul Awal arrested in murder case
summary: The former chief election commissioner was shown arrested in a case regarding the killing of garment worker Rubel during the July 2024 mass uprising.
details: Former chief election commissioner Kazi Habibul Awal has been formally arrested in a murder case. He was shown arrested on Sunday by a Dhaka court.
The case involves the killing of garment worker Rubel in the capital's Adabor area during the July 2024 mass uprising.
Awal had been in jail since June 25 last year in a sedition case filed by the BNP, alleging elections were held without people's votes.
He had secured bail from the High Court in the sedition case on September 9 and was awaiting release when investigators sought his arrest in the murder case.
According to the case statement, police and Awami League activists opened fire on protesters in Adabor on August 5, 2024, leaving Rubel with gunshot wounds.
Rubel was declared dead at a nearby hospital. His father, Rafiqul Islam, filed the case with Adabor Police Station on August 22, 2024.
caption:
Former CEC Habibul Awal was just shown arrested in a murder case as he was awaiting release from jail on bail.

Former chief election commissioner Kazi Habibul Awal has been formally arrested in a murder case. He was shown arrested on Sunday by a Dhaka court.

The case involves the killing of garment worker Rubel in the capital's Adabor area during the July 2024 mass uprising.

Awal had been in jail since June 25 last year in a sedition case filed by the BNP, alleging elections were held without people's votes.

He had secured bail from the High Court in the sedition case on September 9 and was awaiting release when investigators sought his arrest in the murder case.

According to the case statement, police and Awami League activists opened fire on protesters in Adabor on August 5, 2024, leaving Rubel with gunshot wounds.

Rubel was declared dead at a nearby hospital. His father, Rafiqul Islam, filed the case with Adabor Police Station on August 22, 2024.

Source: Prothom Alo, bdnews24.com
